question.text: What is a 'Shell Financial Institution' and what is the restriction regarding correspondent banking relationships with such entities?

answer.text: A shell financial institution has no physical presence in any country and is not affiliated with a regulated financial group; correspondent relationships must not be entered into with such entities
A shell financial institution is a small bank with fewer than 100 employees; correspondent banks may enter relationships with prior approval
A shell financial institution is a newly licensed bank that has been operating for less than one year; relationships are allowed with enhanced monitoring
A shell financial institution is a foreign bank operating without a license in India; relationships are permitted if the bank is licensed in its home country

explanation.text: The Logic: In standard AML/CFT usage (consistent with FATF Recommendation 13 and the IFSCA Guidelines), a "Shell Financial Institution" is a financial institution that has no physical presence in the country where it is incorporated and licensed and is not affiliated with a regulated financial group that is itself subject to effective consolidated supervision. Because such an entity sits outside meaningful regulatory oversight, the IFSCA Guidelines prohibit Regulated Entities from entering into correspondent banking or other business relationships with it. The Trap: Option B (small bank below 100 employees with prior approval) and option C (newly licensed bank under one year with enhanced monitoring) describe size or tenure tests that have nothing to do with the shell definition. Option D describes an unlicensed foreign bank, but the defining feature of a shell financial institution is absence of physical presence and absence of affiliation to a supervised group, not the licensing status in any single jurisdiction. Note: The cited pages of the NISM-IFSCA-01 workbook (p.80, p.94) state the prohibition on entering into correspondent or business relationships with a Shell Financial Institution, but the detailed definition of a Shell Financial Institution as having no physical presence and no regulated-group affiliation was not located in the pages checked. The definition above is general FATF/IFSCA regulatory knowledge.
